headline: Larry Ellison Personally Guaranteed $40.4 Billion of His Son's Warner Bros. Discovery Deal. Now 12 States Have Sued to Block It, and Oracle Stock Has Fallen 34% This Month.
summary: Larry Ellison's fortune, Oracle's stock, and Hollywood's biggest merger are now deeply intertwined -- and investors should understand why the outcome could matter far beyond the entertainment industry.

headline: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger amid claims of antitrust violations
summary: Jul. 24—OLYMPIA — The Paramount Skydance planned merger with Warner Bros. has been halted as a federal judge considers whether the deal violates antitrust laws and unfairly reduces market competition.
